title: FOSS Earth · repository split
summary: Shared globe, viewer and tools, with no dependency on downstream applications.
ownershipNote: FOSS Earth owns shared globe/viewer/tooling code. It imports no flight or campus applications, and it contains no downstream application graph or manifest data.

groups.title: Globe application & owned data
groups.note: Standalone Earth, with its own manifest and branding.

groups.title: Shared FOSS Earth modules
groups.note: Globe-neutral code consumed by Earth and applications.

groups.title: Scenes and 360 image structures
groups.note: 360 composes independent formats; common image services coordinate resources.

nodes.name: foss-earth/foss-earth.github.io
nodes.detail: Published globe application and Earth-specific composition, branding, release pins, developer contributions and manifest data.

nodes.name: foss-earth/engine
nodes.detail: Proposed shared globe-engine extraction: terrain, imagery, coordinates, authoritative surface queries, globe camera/input and world integration. It consumes the shared renderer for scene/device/frame services.
nodes.note: Globe code owns maps and surface queries. Renderer owns device, scene, backends and frame scheduling; its API has no import back into the globe engine.

nodes.name: foss-earth/ui
nodes.detail: Generic windows/tabs, settings registry/types/widgets, contribution registration, status log and report contracts. Each host registers its own feature catalogs and callbacks.
nodes.note: UI imports neither globe/renderer implementations nor flight/campus packages. Toolbar and feature panels consume its primitives. Shared ?dev=1 plumbing activates only host-registered developer contributions.

nodes.name: foss-earth/about
nodes.detail: Shared build identity/provenance and dependency graph viewer. Reads a host-supplied manifest without importing any described runtime.
nodes.note: Viewer code belongs to FOSS Earth; application-branded data, release pins and graph content belong to each application.

nodes.name: foss-earth/sky
nodes.detail: Shared astronomy, clear atmosphere, stars, physical lighting and optional renderer/panels.
nodes.note: Terrain-lighting, settings and scene-time ports are supplied by the host. No import back into globe engine and no flight dependency.

nodes.name: foss-earth/weather
nodes.detail: Canonical world weather definition, sampling, sources, optional rendering and shared panel. Aircraft samples and visuals consume one field.
nodes.note: The larger weather model is a specification, not a completed extraction. Core imports neither globe runtime nor JSBSim.

nodes.name: foss-earth/scenes
nodes.detail: Scene manifest envelope, reference validation, placements, groups/links, navigation orchestration and Scenes panel. Composes the 360 viewer through public interfaces.
nodes.note: World, height and camera services arrive through host ports. Scene validation uses registered representation validators; formats do not import scene or globe code.

nodes.name: foss-earth/360
nodes.detail: Top-level 360-image viewer, orb/immersion presentation, entry/exit and motion/input through supplied ports, representation registration and preparation-tool composition.
nodes.note: Consumes independent image structures and shared resource services. It never imports scene, globe, campus or flight implementations.

nodes.name: foss-earth/images
nodes.detail: Common image identity, decoded records, orientation/color helpers, header validation, transport/cache, cancellation and coordinated resource reservations.
nodes.note: Pure core imports no concrete format, renderer, viewer or scene. One supplied broker accounts for representation residency and replacement overlap.

nodes.name: foss-earth/equirectangular
nodes.detail: Full 2:1 spherical image records/schema, direction-to-UV mapping, seam/pole handling, estimates, loading/sampling, preparation and validation.
nodes.note: Pure core and preparation entry points are separate from the GPU adapter. JPEG and PNG are codecs for this same spatial structure.

nodes.name: foss-earth/cubemap
nodes.detail: Six named cube faces, orientation conventions, direction lookup, seam filtering, estimates, preparation and whole-cube loading/sampling.
nodes.note: Exports pure face geometry for tiled-cubemap and preview-sheets. It never imports those consumers or the 360 viewer.

nodes.name: foss-earth/tiled-cubemap
nodes.tab: Image structure · tiled cube, EAC and gnomonic
nodes.detail: Six face quadtrees, tile addressing/LOD/selection, scheduler, cancellation/residency, GPU atlas/display table, preparation and sampling.
nodes.note: Gnomonic and equi-angular are explicit warps of the same stored tile structure. Both use one shared scheduler and the supplied resource broker.

nodes.name: foss-earth/preview-sheets
nodes.detail: Preview-sheet and placement extension, packing/extraction, file checking, shared sheet reads and fallback to the original six face files.
nodes.note: Uses pure cubemap face conventions and common image services. It supplies decoded face regions; cubemap owns GPU upload.

nodes.name: foss-earth/dev
nodes.detail: Shared developer-tab plumbing, graph/debug widget services and the ?dev=1 activation contract. Hosts register distinct app-owned developer panels.
nodes.note: This framework does not import simulator debug code or a particular tour. Enabling Dev does not create another physics loop.

nodes.name: foss-earth/dev_installer
nodes.detail: Generic setup/update/doctor machinery that reads an explicit versioned workspace manifest. It does not hardcode downstream projects or import their runtime packages.

nodes.name: foss-earth/ci
nodes.detail: Shared reviewed workflows, checks and authorship validator machinery. Each consumer owns a thin pinned workflow entry point and its component-specific tests.
nodes.note: Tooling reuse is not a runtime dependency. The shared validator does not own app-specific build or qualification claims.

nodes.name: FOSS Earth release manifest
nodes.detail: The standalone globe release/dependency manifest. It includes no flight or campus application graph/content.

nodes.name: FOSS Earth workspace manifest
nodes.detail: Canonical globe/shared-module checkouts, revisions, toolchain requirements and build order. No downstream application checkout is required.

nodes.name: Felipegalind0/gamepad-tools
nodes.detail: Public controller handling consumed by globe input.

nodes.name: foss-earth/docs
nodes.detail: Shared globe/module docs, architecture, integration contracts and public documentation. Does not consume flight-owned documentation.

nodes.name: foss-earth/research
nodes.detail: Sky/weather/terrain/panorama studies, alternatives and reproducible comparisons owned by FOSS Earth.

nodes.name: foss-earth/.github
nodes.detail: FOSS Earth contribution documents and templates; executable shared checks live in foss-earth/ci.

nodes.name: foss-earth/renderer
nodes.detail: Shared device/scene lifecycle, WebGPU/WebGL backends, readiness, frame scheduler and optional Renderer panel.
nodes.note: Renderer never imports the globe engine. Its optional panel consumes UI; map and aircraft contributions arrive through explicit services.

nodes.name: foss-earth/toolbar
nodes.detail: Bottom HUD layout and display of registered callbacks/values. Hosts supply map, position, renderer, input and app-specific items through public contracts.
nodes.note: Consumes generic UI primitives. It does not import the implementations whose values/buttons it shows; each setting still has one tab home.
